description: This file contains a series of shell script functions and test cases for testing git rebase operations, specifically focusing on rebasing complex, non-linear commit histories with merges and cherry-picks.

methods.name: test_revision_subjects
methods.description: Compares git log subject lines to expected string to verify commit messages.

methods.name: test_run_rebase
methods.description: Runs git rebase with specified options and verifies the rebasing logic for different scenarios involving complex histories.
